shared_elements: incised/carved motifs on a stone surface
circle or ring with central dot
repeated abstract motifs covering the surface
justification: Both are stone surfaces bearing non-figurative-looking carved motifs, and each includes small ringed circles or discs alongside curved band elements, which is the most specific correspondence. Otherwise they differ fundamentally: A is a monumental sculpted human-form block with sparse, shallow relief symbols arranged vertically over a body, while B is a compact slab densely covered with fine, continuous incised zigzag and barbed linework converging on a beaked head — different technique, scale and compositional logic.
